slides.title: Status messages make action unmistakable
slides.takeaway: A static status message combines semantic tone, a visible label, concise context, and an explicit owner without relying on motion or interaction.

elements.text: Use semantic color only when the message carries that meaning.
Name one accountable owner before the next gate so the audience knows who acts.

slides.notes: Static native status-message pattern. Replace bracketed owner and date placeholders. Keep the warning treatment only when a real decision or risk exists.

slides.title: Ownership stays visible at a glance
slides.takeaway: Static persona blocks identify accountable roles and decision rights without simulating interactive profile controls.

elements.text: Ownership stays visible at a glance
Show role, responsibility, and decision relationship in one scan.

slides.notes: Static native persona pattern using generic role examples. Replace roles and descriptions with the actual governance model.

slides.title: Progress exposes the next decision
slides.takeaway: A determinate static track shows completed, current, and future gates while making the next required action visible.
slides.notes: Static native determinate-progress pattern. Replace the illustrative count, gate names, and date with sourced program data.

slides.title: Tables make ownership comparable
slides.takeaway: A compact native table supports repeated executive scanning when each column has a clear purpose and status remains visibly labeled.

elements.text: Keep columns purposeful and use text with every status color.

slides.notes: Static native table pattern with illustrative rows. Replace every row with sourced workstream data and preserve text or shape cues alongside status color.

slides.title: Labels organize metadata without noise
slides.takeaway: Compact static tags make category, priority, and status scannable when color remains restrained and semantically meaningful.

elements.text: Use neutral labels for taxonomy and semantic labels only for real status.

slides.notes: Static native tag pattern. Neutral and brand tags classify content; success, warning, and danger tags are reserved for truthful status.

slides.title: KPIs pair the number with meaning
slides.takeaway: A static KPI block needs a labeled value, comparison context, timeframe, and source rather than an isolated oversized number.

elements.text: KPIs pair the number with meaning
Bracketed values mark evidence that must be supplied before publication.

slides.notes: Static native KPI pattern. Every bracketed metric, comparator, date, and source must be replaced with verified evidence before publication.
